procedural_matters: The panel of the International Jury was composed in accordance with RRS N1.4(b).
The hearing was scheduled on the ONB at 18:45 for a starting time of 19:10.
GBR 4271, bow 51, did not come to the hearing, the hearing proceeded in accordance with RRS 63.1(b).
GBR 4034, bow 23, was represented by Mark Prue.
facts: Wind was 12-15 knots and waves were mildly choppy.
Race 7 on leg 6 downwind to the finish line.
GBR 4271, bow 51, was one boat length to leeward of GBR 4034, bow 23, and clear astern at the zone.
Inside the zone, GBR 4271, bow 51, established an overlap from behind to leeward of GBR 4034, bow 23.
When GBR 4034, bow 23, was at two boat lengths, GBR 4271, bow 51, luffed pointing to windward of the mark.
There was contact between the pulpit of GBR 4271, bow 51, and the main sheet of GBR 4034, bow 23.
When GBR 4034, bow 23, was one and a half boat lengths from the mark, GBR 4271, bow 51, slowed down and bore away.
GBR 4034, bow 23, then bore down and crossed the finish line, finishing race 7.
conclusions: GBR 4271, bow 51, did not give mark-room and they broke rule 18.2(a)(2).
GBR 4271, bow 51, did not avoid contact and they broke rule 14(a).
GBR 4034, bow 23, to windward failed to keep clear of GBR 4271, bow 51, to leeward, and broke RRS 11.
Since GBR 4034, bow 23, broke RRS 11 while she was sailing within the mark-room to which she was entitled, she is exonerated under RRS 43.1(b) for this breach.
